{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Shield}}
{{Citation}}
[[File:N-1_Shields.png|thumb|right|250px|A ray shield envelops a [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|Naboo starfighter]].]]
{{Quote|That shield is certainly putting a crimp in my day.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]]|audio=CrimpInMyDay-TCWf.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>}}
'''Deflector shields''', also known as '''deflector screens''', '''security deflector shields''', '''security shields''', '''deflectors''', or simply '''shields''', were translucent or transparent energy fields produced by [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generators]]. These generators could be placed on [[Planet/Legends|planets]], [[Droid/Legends|droids]], [[Starship/Legends|starships]], [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] and individual buildings. The primary purpose of the shield was to block or deflect projectiles and lasers from hitting the object under protection.

==Description==
Deflector shields were electronic energy dampeners that wrapped a structure or [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in a protective screen that was capable of blocking incoming energy and projectile attacks. Expensive to install, deflector shields required a lot of power to operate. However, they were lighter and smaller than [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Deflector shields worked in a layered defense fashion: A volumetric field effect extended out from the surface of the shield projector, attempting to reduce the coherency of any beam attacks and deflect physical objects. The shield itself behaved in a manner similar to that of a thermally conductive material—energy applied was quickly diffused and re-radiated back into the environment, but the shield itself could also absorb some of the energy. The absorbed energy was shunted into [[Heat sink/Legends|heat sinks]], and re-radiated at a lesser rate by the shield and [[Neutrino radiator/Legends|neutrino radiators]]. The use of deflector shields on starfighters and other small craft, made them capable of hypersonic speeds in planetary atmospheres.<ref name="ROTS:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

==Shield types==
{{Quote|Their deflector shield is too strong.|[[Ric Olié/Legends|Ric Olié]]|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
The two most common types of deflector shield were [[Particle shield/Legends|particle shields]] and [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shields]]. Particle shields absorbed kinetic energy from physical impacts such as [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] and [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]], as well as space debris like [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]. Ray shields were effective against energy weapons such as [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]].<ref name="EGWT" />

Ray shields were also used as capture devices onboard [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]; [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] were caught in a ray shield trap onboard [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']]. Although designed to counter energy attacks, the energy given off by the ray shield would likely have disintegrated the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] duo had they attempted to pass through it.

[[File:Gungan_Shield.png|thumb|left|250px|Shields protect the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].]]

The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] shields used during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] blocked lasers, but droids could pass through because of their relatively slow movement in comparison to the laser bolts. Some shields only held back anything with a high-energy output, allowing sentients to pass through unharmed. Others were deadly to anything upon contact. Some [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] droids, notably the [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]], were equipped with shields making them almost invincible in infantry combat.

The strength of a deflector shield was a factor depending on how close the shield was to the projector, the efficiency of the projector, the power applied, and the surface area of the shield. It was common for starship deflectors to be projected a few molecules underneath the hull plating, and then extended outwards to protect hull integrity. Starship shields could handle massive amounts of energy or punishment, although it was possible to disable a shield by concentrating fire on a specific location.

[[File:Rayshields.png|thumb|250px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] are trapped by [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shields]] aboard a Separatist cruiser.]]

Aside from the standard defensive shields carried by most ships, there were other variants:
*[[Shift shield]]s: These shields protected any ship traveling in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] from collisions with interstellar atoms, dust, or dark matter. An unprotected collision would destroy the ship. Failure of the shift shields in a meteor shower was how [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] explained the loss of [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] to the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] prior to its dissolution.<ref name="ANH novel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref>
*[[Thermal shield/Legends|Thermal shields]]: These shields was a more powerful version of the more common deflector shield. Like the deflector shield, Thermal shields could deflect laser and projectile fire and could withstand a direct hit from a volley of [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedoes]]. However, this absorbed at least half of the shield's power. Torpedoes could not be fired while thermal shields were up, as they would not be able to pass through the shield barrier. Once down, the shields could not be raised again until fully recharged. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] was known to have thermal shields installed on a number of his warships, including his [[Invincible/Legends|flagship]]. The shields were used to great effect during the [[Christophsis blockade/Legends|blockade]] of [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]]. However, the recharge time of the shield resulted in the apparent [[Death/Legends|death]] of Trench, after he lowered his shields to fire upon [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] prototype [[Stealth ship/Legends|Stealth ship]]. Thermal shielding was a protective cover for [[ionization reactor]]s aboard the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]].
*[[Relativistic shield]]s: Not shields in the classic sense, but relativistic shields still insulated the user from outside forces, thus justifying their name. Under the normal application of physical laws, as one accelerated to speeds approaching that of light, time would dilate. Time flow was slowed for the traveler, yet for any (relatively) stationary observers, their specific experience of time would be much more rapid than the close-to-lightspeed traveler. Relativistic shields or Stasis fields effectively anchored the contents of the field to a specific relative condition of time passage. This function was essential for travel in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] as it is strongly indicated that physical laws and phenomena do not behave the same there as in [[Realspace/Legends|Realspace]]. Without Stasis fields, after a brief hyperspace jump, perhaps only seconds would have passed, or perhaps one would find themselves untold thousands of years in the future. See also: [[Stasis field/Legends|stasis fields]].
[[File:Droideka-USC.png|thumb|A droideka deploying deflector shields while firing its blasters]]

==History==
[[File:Reinforced_Deflectors_XWM.png|thumb|left|200px|A Mon Calamari star cruiser with reinforced deflector shields]]
{{Quote|The shield must be deactivated if any attack is to be attempted.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]]|<ref name="Episode 6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
Deflector shields were first developed during the early years of space exploration, designed to absorb heat and [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] encountered in space and within a planetary [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. Before the introduction of deflector shields, [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] had to rely solely on thick, armored hulls and panels of reflective armor for protection against meteors and laser attacks. More advanced versions of the energy shield were developed centuries later, until eventually modern shielding was able to combine ray and particle protection. Eventually, shield technology improved enough to allow some ground vehicles to have dedicated shield generators.

Following the [[Waymancy Storm]], [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] master crafter [[Lyns Skutroo]] reverse-engineered the [[Sif-Alulan process]] used by the Waymancy weapons to develop the [[squintpipe process]]. This resulted in a brief period where rapid-firing [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] outclassed any available deflector shield across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], until [[7500s BBY]] when further developments in the squintpipe process resulted in stronger deflector shields.<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

Some of the largest and most powerful deflector shields produced were those that protected the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle stations]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] was protected by a [[SLD-26 planetary shield generator/Legends|SLD-26 planetary shield generator]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. This effectively forestalled any attack against the station, until [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] strike team destroyed the generator.

==Personal shields==
{{Main|Personal energy shield/Legends}}
{{Quote|The Imperials think I'm somehow immortal, but I just have a good supply of power cells.|[[Kyle Katarn]] on the [[Military Mobility Shield]]|<ref name="EGWT" />}}
[[File:Sakiyan_LoNH.png|thumb|right|220px|A [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] female with a personal shield]]
From the era of the [[Jedi Civil War]], [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal shielding]] for individual units was commonplace. There were [[Mandalorian melee shield|melee shields]], [[Echani shield|energy shields]], and [[Verpine prototype shield|Verpine shields]].

By the time of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], personal shields that covered an entire being existed, but produced radiation and magnetic fields that were dangerous for sustained use.
